answer: A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, since the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The lotus multiplier is published, charged in spiral, and sparrow lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 11 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 2653 identities would post 559 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
